title: 第七章 那灵植是我的第八章 魔域
slug: 被弃龙崽崽三界仙兽都是我喂哒
lines: “小贱人你怎么没死？”
宋文妤听到宝贝女儿的声音，进来也看见了玄稷，脸上很是惊诧。
这小贱人不是被周自珩献给邪修了吗？
这会怎么好端端地在这？
看着她身上的血迹，难不成那邪修放过了她？
真是便宜了这小贱人！
既然被放过了，他们能拿她换了一株灵植，就可以再换第二株灵植！
玄稷听着这讨厌的母女叫自己小野种小贱人，根本就不想理她们。
她不是小贱人，也不是小野种。
宋文妤一向是骄横惯了的，见这小贱人竟然敢不理自己，伸手就要打她。
大胖见小主人要被打了，着急之下直接站起来扑向宋文妤。
宋文妤不防被吓一跳。
“哎呦！
这畜牲，我就说怎么找不见你了，原来跑出来找小贱人来了！”
这小贱人竟然还敢拐了家里的狗？
“娘把它抓回去杀了吃狗肉！
甜儿都好就没吃肉了。”
周欣甜看到了大胖，竟然比在家的时候好像多长了点肉，就流口水了。
本来昨晚他们就要杀狗吃肉的，结果没找到它。
玄稷再也听不下去了，直接揽过大胖藏在身后。
“你们不许打大胖的主意，这是我的大胖，不准吃它！”
大胖被小主人保护，心里暖暖的，但它也不准小主人被欺负，朝着宋文妤和周欣甜呲牙。
“呀个小畜生竟然敢呲牙，真是活腻歪了！
看我不打死你，让你今天就变成狗肉锅子！”
宋文妤不惜浪费宝贵的灵力，也要立即把大胖给打死。
只人还没到跟前，却被护主心切的大胖，吐了个火团砸个正着。
“啊——我的脸！”
火团直喷宋文妤的正脸，慌忙灭火。
然就是她动做再快，头发也被燎了前半边，跟个清朝人似的。
一直没出手的范沐禾见状点头。
她就说那狗明明已经成了一阶灵兽了，没道理还打不过一个小小炼气三层。
大胖着急之下吐了个火球后，惊讶的狗嘴一直没闭上。
content_en:
"How come you're not dead, little bitch?"
Song Wenyu heard the voice of her precious daughter, came in and saw Xuan Ji, with a look of surprise on her face.
Wasn't this little bitch sacrificed to the evil cultivator by Zhou Ziheng?
How is this going to happen?
Looking at the blood stains on her body, could it be that the evil cultivator let her go?
This little bitch is really cheap!
Since she was let go, if they could exchange her for a spiritual plant, they could exchange her for a second spiritual plant!
Xuan Ji listened to this annoying mother and daughter calling him a little bastard and a little bitch, and didn't want to pay attention to them at all.
She is not a little bitch, nor is she a little bastard.
Song Wenyu had always been arrogant. Seeing that this little bitch dared to ignore her, she reached out and wanted to hit her.
Seeing that his little master was about to be beaten, the fat man stood up and rushed towards Song Wenyu in a hurry.
Song Wenyu was unexpectedly startled.
"Ouch!
This beast, I said why can't I find you? It turned out that you ran out to find the little bitch! "
This little bitch actually dared to abduct the family dog?
“Mom, take it back, kill it and eat it as dog meat!
The sweets are so good that I don’t eat meat. "
Zhou Xintian drooled when she saw Big Fat, who seemed to have gained a little more weight than when she was at home.
They were going to kill the dog for meat last night, but they didn't find it.
Xuan Ji couldn't listen anymore, so he directly took the big fat man and hid it behind him.
"You are not allowed to have any ideas about Big Fatty. This is my Big Fatty. You are not allowed to eat it!"
Big Fatty was protected by his little master and felt warm in his heart, but he also refused to allow his little master to be bullied and bared his teeth at Song Wenyu and Zhou Xintian.
"This little beast dares to bare his teeth, he's so tired of living!
If I don’t beat you to death, you will become a dog-meat pot today! "
Song Wenyu didn't hesitate to waste precious spiritual energy and wanted to beat Big Fat to death immediately.
Before the man could reach him, the protector's eager fat man spit out a ball of fire and hit him.
"Ah—my face!"
The fire shot directly into Song Wenyu's face, and she hurriedly put out the fire.
However, no matter how fast she moved, the front half of her hair was burned, just like someone from the Qing Dynasty.
Fan Muhe, who had never made a move, nodded when he saw this.
She said that the dog had obviously become a first-level spiritual beast, so there was no reason why it couldn't defeat a small third-level Qi refining person.
After the fat man spit out a fireball in a hurry, the surprised dog's mouth never closed.
